scenarios.upstreamTest: Tree > should have the expected attributes on the rows

scenarios.upstreamTest: Tree > should support dynamic trees

scenarios.upstreamTest: AriaTree > should have the base set of aria and data attributes

scenarios.upstreamTest: Tree > empty state > should allow the user to tab to the empty tree

scenarios.upstreamTest: Tree > keyboard interactions > should navigate between visible rows when using Arrow Up/Down
scenarios.notes: Arrow Up moves one visible row up.

scenarios.upstreamTest: Tree > keyboard interactions > should navigate between visible rows when using Arrow Up/Down

scenarios.upstreamTest: Tree > keyboard interactions > should navigate between visible rows when using Home/End

scenarios.upstreamTest: Tree > keyboard interactions > left and right arrows should navigate between interactive elements in the row

scenarios.upstreamTest: Tree > keyboard interactions > left and right arrows should navigate between interactive elements in the row
scenarios.notes: Arrow Left collapses a focused expanded parent row.

scenarios.upstreamTest: Tree > keyboard interactions > should support collapse key to navigate to parent

scenarios.upstreamTest: Tree > keyboard interactions > left and right arrows should navigate between interactive elements in the row

scenarios.upstreamTest: Tree > keyboard interactions > left and right arrows should navigate between interactive elements in the row
scenarios.notes: Arrow Left walks back toward the row through the row's interactive elements.

scenarios.upstreamTest: Tree > keyboard interactions > should support type ahead

scenarios.upstreamTest: Tree > keyboard interactions > should support type ahead

scenarios.upstreamTest: Tree > expanding and collapsing > should expand/collapse a row when clicking/using Enter on the row itself and there arent any other primary actions

scenarios.upstreamTest: Tree > expanding and collapsing > should expand/collapse a row when clicking/using Enter on the row itself and there arent any other primary actions

scenarios.upstreamTest: Tree > expanding and collapsing > should expand/collapse a row when clicking/using Enter on the row itself and there arent any other primary actions
scenarios.notes: A child collapsed before its parent kept its collapsed state on re-expand.

scenarios.upstreamTest: Tree > expanding and collapsing > should not expand when clicking/using Enter on the row if the row is selectable

scenarios.upstreamTest: Tree > expanding and collapsing > should not expand when clicking/using Enter on the row if the row is selectable

scenarios.upstreamTest: Tree > should render checkboxes for selection using Checkbox
